notes: Twelve cross-wing and cross-fleet bonds for the bomber, ford, battleship, seaplane and fog heroes: rivals over a contested sky, two ford-takers, the company's biggest guns, and the pretenders of the eyes line.

motifs: the bomber that keeps coming back
a saint who counts to three

C.title: Three is enough
beats: Kettle's Archangel logs every Phoenix it has dropped. Vell has asked to see the list.
Three kills on you. I stopped there, out of courtesy.
Courtesy is how you end up with a fourth.
Then the courtesy is mine to regret.

B.title: Cleared hot
beats: They shared a ceiling for one afternoon. Kettle held the flak, and Vell took the run.
You had me in the reticle for the whole approach.
Old habit. I kept thinking you were the other side.
I am the other side. I'm just on loan.

A.title: Same sky, other end
beats: A Phoenix came home smoking. Kettle's Ferret walked her wing in to the pad.
Fourth pass. I'd have bet against it.
You'd have lost, and enjoyed it.
Next time I shoot you, I'll aim to miss. Do not tell the others.

C.title: Arrears
beats: Nox asks Vell how many times she has been shot down. Vell asks Nox how long the sky has been owed.
Three crashes, one form filed. I think I'm ahead of you.
Nobody is ahead of the sky.

B.title: Filing
beats: Nox keeps a column in the ledger for her. It is headed Phoenix, returns.
You are the only entry that pays back.
Fire comes back. That's all it is.
Then it is the one debt I like.

A.title: Fair weather
beats: Nox held the anti-nuke ring while the Phoenixes came in low through its shadow.
That column is closed, then. Thank you for the paperwork.
Open a new one. I'll be back.

motifs: fire that returns and fire that walks

C.title: Two ways to burn
beats: Brakhov watches a Phoenix pair peel off a burning turret line and turn for home.
I return. It's a different verb.
I do not know that verb.

B.title: The same char
beats: She came back through the Kiln's smoke and landed with soot on her canopy that was not hers.
You went in first and left me the good ash.
I leave everything the good ash.
Then I'll keep landing in it.

A.title: Slow and fast
beats: Her bombs opened the gate, and Brakhov walked through before it stopped glowing.
Eight hundred paces. You made it three hundred shorter.
I am asking now. Come back again.

C.title: Whose edge
beats: The Scylla sits off the shore. The Warder's beamer ring sits on it. The shoreline belongs to both.
That sand is inside my circle.
That sand is inside my range.

B.title: Overlap
beats: A raiding party landed on the beach. The battleship shelled it, and a beamer finished what was left.
The shell made the crater. You only stood in it.

A.title: Border terms
beats: Voss drew a line on the chart at the tide mark. Warder paced it out and left a stake at each end.
Your water, my dirt. I will not apologise for the stakes.
I would not accept an apology. I'd consider it a retreat.
Good. We understand each other, and I still do not like it.

motifs: the biggest guns in the company
a ship that walks, a house that knocks

C.title: Heavy company
beats: The war room puts the Scylla and the Fatboy at the same end of the table. The table lists a little.
You're a ship that forgot the sea.
I would have called that rude, but it is accurate.

B.title: Two lanes of thunder
beats: She hit the citadel from the bay while he came up the road. They fired within a heartbeat.
Then the citadel had a very bad quarter-hour.

A.title: Neighbours
beats: Evening in camp. The ship rides the harbour, and the house sits on the quay above her.
Good. It would be a short conversation and a long echo.

C.title: Draft and debt
beats: The Auditor wades down the slip and starts counting the Scylla's turrets. Voss lets it finish.
Nine barrels. Sixty-one hundred rounds. Who pays?
The coast, when I'm done with it.
I will note that as a promise.

B.title: Cost of a salvo
beats: After the bombardment, the Auditor posts a tally on the pier. The figure is large.
One hundred and four shells. The shore owes nothing, but I record it.
Someone has to. You'd rather not know the number, Commander.

A.title: Reckoning at low tide
beats: The tide went out and left the Scylla's keel two metres from the sea. The Auditor stood beside it, silent for once.
Go on. Count the days I can't sail.
Four. I wrote five and corrected it.
I'll allow you the correction. I'll never allow the ledger.

C.title: Cloaked scouting
beats: Three Horizons skim a lake while Veil's jammer rolls a grey bank in behind them.
Hiding is a service. Billing comes later.
I'd pay for a haze that shows only me.

B.title: Invisible lead
beats: She flew the bombers in behind the fog, with nothing on the enemy radar but a flicker.
They saw nothing, and then it was too late to look.
A lovely invoice. I'll add it.

A.title: Eyes first
beats: The Horizons found the target, Veil blinded the watchers, and the Tsunamis dropped through a grey gap.
I've never been so sure of what I couldn't see.
Bill the company. I'll tell them we're worth it.

motifs: the seaplane wing leader and the night-flyer

C.title: Lanes and altitude
beats: Noctua unrolls a map of flight paths, in colour, over the lake. Harrow squints at the lowest one.
That is where your Horizons fly.
That's where they have always flown. I keep them wet.
Fly them higher and they'd see further.

B.title: Landing practice
beats: Harrow taught the drone-bay a seaplane landing. Noctua insisted on a swarm.
One at a time. The water forgives gently.
A hundred of them, and it forgives them all at once.
Then I'll bring the lecture notes.

A.title: Night run
beats: The Tsunami wing flew a night strike through Noctua's drone corridor. It was the first time they all came home dry.
You flew a road in the dark, and gave the credit to me.
You taught me that the water will always catch you.
I only said it. You made it true.

motifs: bombers coming in low off the water

C.title: Low and wet
beats: Four Tsunamis cross the shoreline at ten metres. Kettle's Archangel swings to follow.
I am under it. There is a difference.

B.title: Friendly fire, very friendly
beats: The Archangel fired a salvo at an unmarked wing and got within a hair of the Tsunamis.
You flew in without a call sign.
I flew in with a plan. You'd have heard it if you asked.

A.title: A corridor each
beats: They split the lake in two on the map. High for the saint, low for the seaplanes.
Your sky is below the line.
Yours is above it. If anyone crosses, we'll both fire.
That is the first thing you have said that I agree with.

motifs: the spare king and the turncoat

C.title: Two faces
beats: Mask wears a commander's plate. Rumor wears whoever she last turned. They size each other up across the mess table.
I'm sure I've seen you somewhere.
Everyone has. It was never me.
Funny. I say the same about myself.

B.title: Payroll and plate
beats: Rumor turned an enemy picket in the morning. Mask's Pawns saluted it in the afternoon.
I get paid for the pretending.
I do it for the pawns. They'd salute a fence post.
You are better at the job. You just don't know you have one.

A.title: Who is in the plate
beats: A cloaked Ghost walked up to Mask in the dark and hesitated. For once Rumor had nothing to say.
I can turn anyone. Not you.
You already switched sides. The Pawns just haven't noticed yet.
